title: QingReDu capsule ameliorates psoriasis vulgaris by regulating EZH2/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Zou, Guoming; Wu, Weiwei; Fang, Cong; Xu, Ke; Liu, Fangrong; Liu, Qiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药胶囊通过EZH2/NF-kappaB通路治疗银屑病，仅涉及分子对接且非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: QingReDu Capsule is commonly used clinically to treat psoriasis vulgaris, the mechanism of treating psoriasis vulgaris is still unclear. Using the ultra-performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS), we analyzed the components in rat plasma after QingReDu Capsule administration. We then predicted the mechanistic pathways of QingReDu Capsule in ameliorating psoriasis vulgaris by screening the intersecting targets of the QingReDu Capsule plasma entry components and psoriasis vulgaris using network pharmacology and molecular docking. Combined with pharmacodynamic evaluation and HE staining, we investigated the efficacy and mechanism of QingReDu Capsule in treating psoriasis vulgaris. Forty-one compounds were identified in the rat plasma after QingReDu Capsule administration, thirty-seven QingReDu Capsule components with the InChI SMILES structure were screened, and two hundred and thirty-five targets intersected with psoriasis vulgaris. network pharmacology revealed that QingReDu Capsule is not only involved in the regulation of the inflammatory response, reactive oxygen species metabolism, and intracellular oxidative stress, but also related to the nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) and mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling pathways. The molecular docking results showed that 10 components, including Myristicin, had good affinity with the screened core targets. The pharmacodynamic results showed that QingReDu Capsule reduced the serum levels of tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin 17 (IL-17), and interleukin 23 (IL-23) by down-regulating the protein levels of enhancer of Zeste Homolog 2 (EZH2) and NF-kappaB, reduced erythema and the scaling of skin lesions, and treated histopathological damage to the skin, such as hyperkeratosis with keratosis imperfecta and the thickening of the sphenoid layer. These findings illustrated that QingReDu Capsule treat psoriasis vulgaris by affecting the EZH2/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and influencing the level of inflammatory factors.
abstract_zh: 青热毒胶囊临床上常用于治疗寻常型银屑病，但其治疗寻常型银屑病的机制尚不明确。采用超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱（UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS）技术，分析了青热毒胶囊给药后大鼠血浆中的成分。随后，通过网络药理学和分子对接技术，筛选青热毒胶囊血浆入血成分与寻常型银屑病的交集靶点，预测青热毒胶囊改善寻常型银屑病的机制通路。结合药效学评价和HE染色，探讨青热毒胶囊治疗寻常型银屑病的疗效及机制。在青热毒胶囊给药后的大鼠血浆中鉴定出41种化合物，筛选出37种具有InChI SMILES结构的青热毒胶囊成分，并与寻常型银屑病交集得到235个靶点。网络药理学结果显示，青热毒胶囊不仅参与炎症反应、活性氧代谢和细胞内氧化应激的调节，还与核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）信号通路相关。分子对接结果表明，包括肉豆蔻醚在内的10种成分与筛选出的核心靶点具有良好的亲和力。药效学结果显示，青热毒胶囊通过下调Zeste同源物2增强子（EZH2）和NF-kappaB的蛋白水平，降低血清中肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）、白细胞介素17（IL-17）和白细胞介素23（IL-23）的水平，减轻皮肤病变的红斑和鳞屑，并改善皮肤组织病理损伤，如角化过度伴角化不全和棘层增厚。这些发现表明，青热毒胶囊通过影响EZH2/NF-kappaB信号通路及炎症因子水平来治疗寻常型银屑病。
